inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment: Training for the following topics regarding annual training on child maltreatment was not observed for director:     (1)Factors indicating a child is at risk for abuse or neglect   (2)Warning signs indicating a child may be a victim of abuse or neglect   (3)Procedures for reporting child abuse or neglect    (4)Community organizations that have training programs available to employees, children,  and parents.     Transportation training for director was also observed expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Walls in the kitchen were observed with yellow residue. Doors leading to the classrooms and walls were observed discolored. Fans and walls were observed with dust and debris.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: 2 out of 4 children's files were observed missing up to date immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: Outdoor play structure was observed altered and only intended for residential use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: Outdoor play structure with a platform of 5ft was observed with less then 1/2 an inch of surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Updated annual fire inspection was not avialble, Last inspection dated 5/4/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two individuals with pending background checks were in operation in contact with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Infant observed in play yard with blanket around infant.     CORRECTED when blanket was removed from infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: Observed 10 children in care of 1 caregiver with 6 children being 18-4yrs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Placement of Groups - Groups Kept Separate: Oberseved infant and toddler area with a removable wall mount division open and accesiible to acces between age groups. Children and caregivers observed to be walking back and forth  through open space of room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Placement of Groups - Groups Kept Separate (26 TAC §746.1505(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: One employee records observed to be missing 20 annual training hours.

When digging into the surfacing observed how the rocks have compressed and compacted making it a harder solid surface in the bottom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: One Infant observed unsupervised on  highchiar in multipurpose room while caregiver assisted that other children in restrooms to wash hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Paint cans and cleaning products observed in cabinets accessible to children, 3 different cabinets did not have a secured lock in the.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Lights during nap time were off in classrooms. eyes needed adjusting when entering a lighted area into the dimmed light classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: One caregiver observed supervising 11 children. . 12mo,15mo,2y,2y,2y,4y,4y,6y,10y,10y,11y.    Operation was out of ratios based on number of children supervised for one caregiver when 12 or fewer children are in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised: One caregiver supervising three different rooms for nap time. One room had 2 infants, second room had 5 children and third room toward back of building has 4 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised (26 TAC §746.2909(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on the information gathered during the investigation it was determined caregiver poured a bottled water down a child back as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information gathered during the investigation caregiver did not exercise self-control as a child was disciplined in front of the whole class humiliating the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunizations-Immunization record must include the child's name and birth date: One child records reviewed missing immunization record in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunizations-Immunization record must include the child's name and birth date (26 TAC §746.623(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: School age room observed durring naptime. room was dark with no lights and windows covered.     CORRECTED at inspection when a curtian was opened to let some natural light in and when the restroom light was turned on with the door open.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present: A total of 21 children were counted in nap time ratio, but divided into two separate classroom areas with 2 caregivers for naptime. One classroom was left unsupervised by caregiver.     CORRECTED at inspection when caregiver was actively supervising the clasroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: 5 children observed in classroom unsupervised during nap time.     CORRECTED  when teacher entered classroom and was walking actively supervising.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

CORRECTED at inspection when instructed caregiver regarding the diapering changing instruction that are available for review on wall and caregiver took child to sink to have their hands washed.
